items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: I've seen, happens with Coltrane, did the same thing.

ctx.x: Everybody up until Miles Davis played an extension of Louis Armstrong. Even though it may have been camouflaged (categorized?) by high style and all that, it was still the basic sound, it was still based on Louis Armstrong and Miles Davis changed the sound. And that's a hard job that he did. It took a lot of work. It took a lot of hard work for him to keep doing it.

And other people came along and just do it because it's a household sound. You know, you can get it, you can get jazz and do it. I've seen, happens with Coltrane, did the same thing. It's a definite original wave form. Billie Holiday had that.
